sources.summary: Ouse Fashion is rooted in Hangzhou , with two decades dedicated to one craft: tailoring the warmth of life into clothing. For them, fashion is not merely about appearance — it is about the ease with which one inhabits their daily life. A corporate lobby is the first point of contact between people and a brand. Employees walk in every day and need to feel a sense of purpose in their work. First-time visitors — the materials, the light, the scale — already speak of the brand's taste and standards. Partners step in, and the lobby should emit a signal of an entire aesthetic system.
